1.explanation: The tooltip is coming from the title attribute automatically applied on each menu item. CascaderMenuItem (in item.jsx) is the component rendering individual items – its render() method should be updated to conditionally omit or override the title attribute when a new prop (e.g. showItemTitle=false) is passed. The top-level Cascader class needs to accept and forward this new prop down to CascaderMenuItem via its renderMenu function. The type definition in types/cascader/index.d.ts must also declare the new API flag in CascaderProps so consumers get correct TS support.
1.bug_scenario: In the Cascader dropdown each menu cell shows a native browser tooltip (the title attribute) on hover – displaying the full path text – but there is no API to disable it. The screenshot shows that even with a custom itemRender, the browser still pops up the title. The request is to add a prop so that consumers can turn off these hover tooltips (title attributes).

2.explanation: The unwanted title attribute is coming from the CascaderMenuItem component’s render method (it passes through all unknown props, including title, into the Menu.Item DOM). To provide a public API to disable titles you need to extend the Cascader component (in src/cascader/cascader.jsx) to accept a new prop (for example `showItemTitle` or similar), propagate that option down into CascaderMenuItem, and then in CascaderMenuItem.render conditionally omit or override the title on the wrapper element. The renderMenu and renderMenus methods in the top-level Cascader class are responsible for creating CascaderMenuItem instances, so they will need to be updated to pass the new flag. Modifying the type definition (types/cascader/index.d.ts) to include the new prop completes the API contract.
2.bug_scenario: In the Cascader menu, when you hover over an item it shows the full label as a browser-native title‐tooltip. The user wants an API/property to disable or remove that title attribute so no tooltip ever appears, especially when they provide their own custom itemRender.
